field_identity.evidence: Block and metric dataset rows contain display keys but no field identity or field descriptor.

raw_value.evidence: A raw JSON value can reach the component, but its type has no business identity.

precision.evidence: No digits or precision declaration exists in the Page Block value carrier.

currency.evidence: No currency field or currency identity exists in the block value.

unit.evidence: The carrier does not declare money, percent, count or duration units.

selection.evidence: No selection identity or option descriptor is carried.

relation_identity.evidence: No relation model, record ID and authoritative label tuple is carried.

temporal_semantics.evidence: No date/datetime type or timezone authority is carried.

attachment_role.evidence: No attachment identity or semantic role is carried.

observed_behavior.positive: Raw numeric values and zero can reach the metric component without an unconditional pre-stringification.
observed_behavior.negative: The same number has no authoritative money/percentage/count/duration identity; object values become JSON text or an empty placeholder depending on the block.

probes.business_effect: A value can look present while its business meaning, precision, unit or identity is unavailable.

responsibility.secondary: P1 block assembly consumes the generic carrier without defining a competing schema

stable_attachment_identity.evidence: Chatter and One2many expose an attachment ID, but Page Block and attachment-zone contracts do not carry a common value object.

record_ownership.evidence: The backend verifies the source record, but the normalized attachment value does not carry owning model and record identity.

semantic_role.evidence: Surface labels and field context exist, but no stable role is declared across bill evidence, collaboration and workflow evidence.

preview_download_action.evidence: Chatter can declare can_download/download_intent and form contracts can declare file.download, but Page Blocks and attachment zones do not receive a universal action declaration.

failure_feedback.evidence: Attachment failures are component-local text without a declared reason code, message and trace identity.

observed_behavior.positive: An authenticated chatter attachment can carry an ID and an explicit download intent; label and count inference are not used by the FCF-02-1 shared authority.
observed_behavior.negative: The same attachment fact has different partial shapes across form, chatter, One2many and attachment-zone contracts; role, ownership and failure identity are not universally present.

probes.business_effect: A rendered attachment may lack a stable, authorized and actionable business identity.

responsibility.secondary: Existing governed attachment APIs remain execution authority

action_target.evidence: Targets exist in action_schema and some dataset rows, but block actions usually carry only key and label.

permission_result.evidence: Role/capability visibility is not a resolved allowed/enabled permission result.

disabled_reason.evidence: No per-action disabled reason is present in blocks or Page Block events.

error_reason_code.evidence: Page-level error envelopes exist, but no Page Block action feedback contract associates a failure with the action identity.

message.evidence: No per-action failure or denial message is carried through the block contract.

trace_identity.evidence: No action/block failure trace identity is carried into the Page Block result.

observed_behavior.positive: A declared target can be forwarded through the action event.
observed_behavior.negative: Visible actions have no uniform permission result or disabled reason; some components synthesize open_scene when an action key is absent; no block action result carries reason, message or trace identity.

probes.business_effect: A user can be shown a non-executable action or a failure without the authoritative explanation and recovery identity.

responsibility.secondary: Existing action and authorization services remain decision authority

dependency_effect.required_next_batch: P0 producer remediation for Page Block value, attachment identity/actions and Page Block action/feedback declarations
